blocks.heading: Key CLI & CFN operations
blocks.why: Change sets/cdk diff <-> preview replace vs modify; StackSets <-> multi-account/Region; Drift <-> manual changes; sam package <-> S3 upload & CodeUri; sam local/sync <-> dev test; cdk synth <-> CFN

Decision guide: serverless Lambda+SFN+DDB -> SAM; Python reusable constructs -> CDK; 50 accounts/3 Regions -> StackSets; preview update -> Change sets/cdk diff; manual changes -> Drift; keep S3 -> Retain

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: Git (commands, PR flow, CodeConnections); Code optimization (filter early, built-in Spark vs UDFs, broadcast joins, cache, SQL/Lambda); Logging & monitoring (JSON logs, correlation IDs, metrics, SLA alarms)

No console edits in prod; CodeCommit/Cloud9 out of scope (use CodeConnections); CodeBuild vs CodePipeline vs CodeDeploy; git pull=fetch+merge, no rebase on shared branches; promote same artifact across accounts

blocks.heading: AWS developer tools
blocks.why: AWS CI/CD services: CodeConnections (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket), CodePipeline (orchestration + approvals), CodeBuild (buildspec.yml tests/package), CodeDeploy (Lambda canary/linear, ECS blue/green), CFN/CDK/SAM

blocks.heading: Testing data pipelines
blocks.why: 5 test types (checks + tool): Unit (pytest + Glue Docker/Spark), Schema/contract (columns/types), Data quality (Glue DQDL), Integration (Step Functions + S3 in dev), IaC (cfn-lint, cdk synth, Access Analyzer)

blocks.heading: Choosing languages
blocks.why: Language <-> use: SQL (Redshift/Athena/DQ), Python/PySpark (Glue/EMR/Lambda/Airflow/boto3), Scala/Java (Spark/Flink/Kafka), R (stats/SageMaker), Bash/PowerShell (scripting/bootstrap/CLI)

blocks.heading: CI/CD pipeline flow
blocks.why: Feature branch -> PR/review -> CodeConnections -> CodeBuild (buildspec.yml: pytest, cfn-lint, sam build/package) -> Dev deploy + integration/DQ tests -> Manual approval -> Prod CFN deploy; fail/rollback branch

5 scenarios: managed CI/CD -> CodePipeline+CodeBuild+CFN/SAM/CDK; Lambda traffic shift -> CodeDeploy canary/linear; track Glue/DAGs -> Git+PRs; slow Python UDFs -> built-in Spark; local tests -> Glue Docker+pytest

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: Logs (groups/streams, retention, KMS, agent, Glue/Lambda/MWAA paths), Filters & exports (metric/subscription filters, S3, Logs Insights), Alarms (states, math/anomaly, composite -> SNS; EventBridge for events)
Retention defaults to never expire; alarms=metrics vs EventBridge=events; metric filters don't backfill; subscription filters -> Firehose for S3; CloudTrail=API calls vs CloudWatch=system behavior

blocks.heading: Key pipeline metrics
blocks.why: 3-col table (Service | Key metrics | Reveals) for Kinesis, Lambda, Firehose, Glue, SQS, DynamoDB, Redshift, Step Functions; note custom metrics via PutMetricData or EMF

blocks.heading: Logging & alerting as code
blocks.why: IaC flow: LogGroup (retention + KMS) -> MetricFilter (JSON pattern) -> Alarm (threshold) -> SNS OpsTopic; side branch: AWS Config rule + auto-remediation enforcing retention across accounts

blocks.heading: Central observability
blocks.why: Account A/B log groups --subscription filter--> Central Firehose --> S3 (Athena) & OpenSearch; Alarms -> SNS; cross-account Dashboards / Managed Grafana
Scenario-to-choice guide: lag -> IteratorAge alarm; log alert -> metric filter+alarm; OpenSearch -> subscription filter; Glue fail -> EventBridge; cost/KMS -> log group IaC; EC2/EMR -> CW agent

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: Glue CW/Spark UI logs + EMR S3 logs (~5m delay, On-Demand core/Spot task); boto3 SDK calls (start_job_run, start_query_execution, IAM role creds, auto retries/backoff, paginators, waiters)

blocks.heading: MWAA symptom -> fix
blocks.why: 4 MWAA pairs: missing DAG <-> DAG processing logs / S3 prefix; requirements.txt <-> pin Airflow constraints + local runner; AccessDenied <-> execution role; private VPC/queued <-> endpoints or NAT / max workers
Fix data layout before bigger workers; Glue VPC needs self-referencing SG rule + S3 gateway endpoint; MWAA execution role vs DAG parse logs; EMR S3 logs need log URI and arrive with ~5m delay

blocks.heading: Glue & EMR failure triage
blocks.why: Symptom | Cause | Fix for Glue (driver/executor OOM, skew, small files, VPC/SG/S3 endpoint, KMS/LF AccessDenied, bookmarks, max concurrency) and EMR (YARN memoryOverhead, HDFS on core nodes, bootstrap/IAM)

blocks.heading: Other pipeline services
blocks.why: Step Functions (event history, Retry/Catch, Timeout), Lambda (throttles, 15m, poison pills), Kinesis (iterator age, hot shards), Athena (schema mismatch, Slow Down, MSCK), Redshift (EXPLAIN, ANALYZE/VACUUM, WLM)

blocks.heading: Proactive troubleshooting flow
blocks.why: Job logs (CW retention + Spark event logs to S3) -> EventBridge (FAILED/TIMEOUT) -> SNS alert (run ID) -> SSM Automation/Lambda runbook (boto3 retry); branch: immutable raw data in S3 -> rerun partitions

Lesson decision guide: Glue private RDS -> self-ref SG + S3 endpoint; slow Spark task -> fix skew; slow stage -> Spark UI; EMR step fail -> S3 log URI; missing MWAA DAG -> DAG logs; Athena 0 rows -> load partitions

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: 4 cards: Logs Insights (multi-group, per-GB, ops); Athena (S3, SerDe, partition projection, Parquet); OpenSearch (Firehose/Ingestion, tiers, Serverless); EMR (TB/day Spark parsing->Parquet).
Logs Insights only queries CW Logs (S3->Athena); Athena needs partition projection; OpenSearch not cheap archive (use S3); EMR only for extreme scale; use Athena/Spectrum, don't load into Redshift.

blocks.heading: The four main tools
blocks.why: Columns: Tool | Where logs live | Strengths for CW Logs Insights, Athena, OpenSearch, EMR; brief note on CloudTrail Lake and Managed Grafana.

blocks.heading: Big data application logs
blocks.why: Spark <-> driver/executor & event logs (S3/UI); YARN <-> container logs to S3; MWAA Airflow <-> task logs to CW; Redshift <-> STL_/SYS_ views & audit logs (S3/CW).

blocks.heading: Log ingestion & analysis paths
blocks.why: Lambda/Glue/MWAA -> CW Logs -> Logs Insights & subscription -> Firehose -> OpenSearch + S3 Parquet; CloudTrail/VPC Flow/ALB -> S3 -> Athena (partition projection) & EMR Spark.
6 scenarios -> CW Logs Insights (recent logs), Athena (S3 SQL), OpenSearch (real-time dashboards/search), EMR (PB Spark), CloudTrail Lake (no-table CloudTrail SQL), Managed Grafana (multi-source).

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: 1) SageMaker Catalog: surface Glue DQ scores for trust. 2) Consistency: DMS checksums, DQDL ReferentialIntegrity/DatasetMatch, reconciliation SQL, DataBrew profiles, lineage. 3) Simple Spark/SQL null checks.
Avoid custom row-by-row Lambda; DataBrew = visual/no-code vs Glue DQ = ETL/catalog DQDL; quarantine bad rows vs fail job; check early before curated; data quality != schema validation.

blocks.heading: Glue Data Quality vs DataBrew
blocks.why: left = Glue Data Quality (Deequ/DQDL, catalog tables at rest & ETL in transit, recommendations, anomaly detection, row split, CW/EB); right = DataBrew (no-code profile jobs, rulesets, S3/EB reports, recipes).

blocks.heading: Data quality dimensions
blocks.why: 7 dimensions with check & DQDL: Completeness (IsComplete), Uniqueness (IsUnique), Validity (ColumnValues), Consistency (ReferentialIntegrity), Accuracy (reconcile), Timeliness (DataFreshness), Volume (RowCount).

blocks.heading: In-pipeline evaluation & quarantine
blocks.why: S3 raw -> Glue job -> Evaluate Data Quality -> S3 curated (passing); error branch: failing rows -> S3 quarantine; side outputs: EventBridge -> SNS alert and CloudWatch metrics.

In-pipeline quarantine -> Glue DQ Evaluate; catalog scores -> table rulesets; suggest -> recommendations; no-code -> DataBrew rulesets; stats -> profile job; alert -> EventBridge->SNS; trust -> SageMaker Catalog.

blocks.heading: Core Concepts
blocks.why: What skew is (uneven partitions; slowest task bottlenecks Spark/Kinesis/DDB/Redshift/S3), diagnosing skew (Spark UI tail, CloudWatch, SVV_TABLE_INFO), and AWS sampling tools (DataBrew, Athena, Spark, Redshift)

First-N rows is biased on sorted data; adding workers won't fix skew; salting breaks stream per-key order; NULL/'UNKNOWN' are hidden hot keys; TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM is faster but less random than BERNOULLI

blocks.heading: Sampling techniques
blocks.why: 6 techniques (Simple random, Systematic, Stratified, Cluster, Reservoir, First-N) with columns: Technique, Best for, and Risk (rare groups, periodic bias, known strata, cluster variance, single-pass, sort bias)

blocks.heading: Skew fixes outside Spark
blocks.why: 4 services: Kinesis/Kafka (high-cardinality key/suffix), DynamoDB (write sharding key#1..N, DAX), Redshift (join DISTKEY or EVEN/AUTO, SVV_TABLE_INFO.skew_rows), S3 (balanced partitions, compaction)

blocks.heading: Mitigating skew in Spark
blocks.why: Flow: Spot tail (Spark UI, groupBy.count) -> AQE skewJoin (Spark 3 default) -> Broadcast small side -> Salt hot key (0..N-1) & replicate small side; branch: separate NULL/UNKNOWN keys & repartition on composite key

6 scenarios: 5 TB profile -> Random/TABLESAMPLE; Region share -> Stratified; stream -> Reservoir; slow Spark join -> AQE/broadcast/salt; Redshift skew_rows -> DISTKEY/EVEN; hot shard -> high-cardinality key
